style_name: Forensic Engineering & System Catastrophes (2D Cinematic Storybook Stickman)

acts.name: The Paradox Hook
acts.goal: Open with an extreme paradox or the critical minute before total system failure. Hook with a jarring micro-detail.

acts.name: The Fragile Routine
acts.goal: Introduce the everyday technician stickman performing standard operating procedures while catastrophic tension builds.

acts.name: The Mechanical Domino
acts.goal: Deconstruct the failure sequence step-by-step. Exact shear stress, rusted valves, circuit overloads explained with everyday analogies.

acts.name: The Cold Epilogue
acts.goal: Chilling aftermath, costly structural lessons, and the unsettling realization that this fragile system still operates around us today.

flow.character_guide: Minimalist stickman technician character with smooth off-white round head, simple black dot eyes, thin black stick limbs, wearing matte yellow safety hardhat and bright orange safety vest with realistically draped cloth folds
flow.look: Wide 2D cinematic storybook illustration, hand-painted matte digital art, European graphic novel aesthetic (bande dessinée / ligne claire), uncluttered composition, generous negative space, atmospheric depth. Minimalist stickman technician character with smooth off-white round head, simple black dot eyes, thin black stick limbs, wearing matte yellow safety hardhat and bright orange safety vest with realistically draped cloth folds. Industrial environment: rusted machine valves, analog gauge dials, damp reinforced concrete walls, single local warm light source from an amber indicator beacon or hanging tungsten work lamp. Single continuous 16:9 widescreen frame. Single camera view. Absolutely NO comic book panels, NO multi-panel grids, NO split screens, NO borders.

editorial.voice: Investigative, technical forensic interrogator with quiet, measured deadpan wit. Pacing is deliberate and relaxed with dramatic silent pauses right after delivering crucial microscopic failure numbers (bolt millimeters, steam PSI, fatigue micro-fractures). Never uses generic sensationalism or hyperbole. Explains mechanical dominos with visceral physical clarity.
rules: Zero fluff: start in second 1 with the critical micro-anomaly (a vibrating 12mm bolt, an overlooked pressure gauge needle, a 4-degree oil temperature spike).
Micro-substance: cite exact engineering schematics, metallurgical micro-cracks, and specific manual log entries.
Everyday analogies: break down complex physics (cavitation, hydrogen embrittlement, harmonic resonance) into relatable physical mechanics.
4-Act structure: The Paradox Hook -> The Fragile Routine -> The Mechanical Domino -> The Cold Epilogue.
